angleRead.name: Nia Rook
angleRead.text: I'm leaning into the vibe in Jack London—the kind of energy where people are still talking about the episode long after the screen goes dark. Briar Soto put on a show that left the books unsettled, and that's where the story is. I'll focus on the friction between the clean technical run—no mishaps, no combat—and the fact that the credits are still a mess. While Clarissa Dane keeps her grip on the top spot, Briar's night is the one people are actually chewing on. I'll keep the technicals as the skeleton but lead with the social fallout.
